batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b RP Singh

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b M Kartik

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b NLTC Perera

batting.name: CH Gayle

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c GH Vihari b CL White

balls.text: another good yorker, 134 kph only, the batsman can only jam it to point for a single
another good delivery on off stump, really full, driven to long-off
another full delivery on the middle stump, the batsman can only hit it as far as long-off
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman drives it towards long-off without much timing, that allows him to come back for the second
full delivery on the stumps again, the batsman drives it down to long-on
oh nice! A yorker that uproots the middle stump is always picturesque. Where is Waqar? He is in the ground too.
it's all over for White! His super effort comes to an end as he drives this half-volley straight into the hands of ABdV who didn't have to budge at all..
full delivery on off from round the wicket, the batsman gets his front leg out of the way, whacks it straight back at the bowler, who boots it to the off side
full delivery on off stump, the batsman drives it down to long-on
beautiful! It's a half volley and it's slow, White gets down on his knee and murders it over extra cover to bring up his fifty
length delivery on off stump from round the wicket, he plays a neat chip down the ground to long-off
low full-toss on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep square leg
he bowls a slower yorker, but it is wide outside off, easy call for Taufel
goes for a yorker, but it's a low full toss on pads, the batsman flicks to to deep square leg
back of length delivery on the stumps, he hops on his toes and steers it to third man

he loses his off stump! Changes his approach! Perera was playing such good tennis, but this time he walks across and tries to paddle a length delivery fine on the leg side, walks too far across and misses..
a good yorker that hits the pads, the batsman starts running immediately, but is sent back by White as RP is charging towards it too.. he gets back in time
high full toss on off, Perera was waiting for anything to swing, he clubs it to deep midwicket boundary
bowls a wide delivery outside off now, it just went over that wide marker but it's good enough to call it a wide for the ump
attempts a yorker, but this one is down the leg side, the batsman watches it go through
bowls a good yorker on the leg stump, the batsman is not able to get under it, flicks it to deep square leg
slower and full outside off, the batsman drives it hard to long-off
better delivery, yorker angling in from round the wicket, the batsman digs it out to long-on
full length delivery from round the wicket, he doesn't get under it properly and gets a thick outside edge to deep point
low full toss on off stump, he lofts it straight over the bowler's head, but the fielder at long-off cuts it off
slower delivery on the middle stump, on a length, now White shows off his golf skills, this one goes miles up in the air, and miles long too.. over wide long-on
caught at deep point but that won't count as it was a high full-toss outside off.. Kohli has a despondent look..
slower delivery on  a length, Perera shows off his awesome power, whacked over cow corner with some ease
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman gets an inside edge to the keeper, who does well to stop that one
slower delivery, White has enough time to line himself up and he slams  this into the empty seats behind deep midwicket
full delivery wide outside off, he stretches out and pushes it to deep cover
haha, fuller length delivery on off, boom he goes, way way deep into the crowd at deep midwicket. Huge hit..
length delivery, slightly slower too, the batsman dabs it towards cover for a single
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman leans forward and stretches out to punch it on the up to the deep extra cover boundary
length delivery on the stumps, touch slower too, the batsman dabs it to the off side and calls for a quick single
misses out as he punches this full-toss outside off to long-off
keep bowling length at him at your own Peril! This guy should try tennis, thwacks it over long-on with ease..
length delivery on off stump, he dabs it towards point and takes a quick single
errs in line! He bowls it shortish and on the leg side, White whacks it to deep backward square leg boundary
short of length delivery outside off, Perera goes for a tennis forehand and gets a top-edge that falls in no-man's land at midwicket. Kohli gets there from cover.. but it's still too far
he gets inside the line of this flatter delivery and tickles it to deep square leg for a single
he waits in the crease and tries to cut the shorter delivery from close to off stump, hit straight to point
this one was flatter and quicker, the batsman tries to flick it to the leg side, but gets hit on the pads
flatter delivery , it is tucked to short fine leg for a single
comes out of the crease and chips it to wide long-on where RP fumbles and allows an extra run
pushed through on the middle stump line, the batsman defends it to midwicket
that extra ball has gives the Hyderabad team some bonus. It was a length ball outside off, in Perera's arc and that has been smacked over long-off a few rows into the crowd
fires this down the leg side preemptively, big wide
stays in the crease and punches it past the non-striker to long-on
comes down the pitch again and this time he drives it along the ground to wide long-on where Murali picks it up and twists and turns to fire in the throw, good stop
he comes down the pitch and flicks it in the air towards deep square leg where Moises makes a good sliding save
this is a full yorker on the middle stump, the batsman jams his bat down and plays it towards midwicket, calls for a quick single
full delivery on the pads, Perera again goes after it, but it takes the inside edge to short fine
length delivery, the batsman goes for a golf swing and aims over long-off, it goes exactly in the opposite direct, down to third man on the bounce
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and pushes it down the ground to long  off
bowls a slower delivery and this one angles across the batsman, he is beaten in his attempt to guide this to third man
he goes on the back foot and punches the length delivery down the ground to long off
back of length outside off, rises up a bit, the batsman defends it to point
good skiddy delivery and it comes in to the batsman from short of length, the batsman tries to whip to the leg side but gets hit on the thigh pad
tossed up delivery on the pads, the batsman defends it to the leg side
he stays in the crease and pushes it to long-off for a single
flatter delivery on the off stump, the batsman punches it firmly back to the bowler
full and flighted on the off stump line, he wrists it away to deep midwicket for a single

and he succeeds it getting to the ball this time, but this is big leading edge as the bowler shortened the length seeing him charge, the ball goes high and high and settles down in the hands of the captain at cover
he charges down the pitch, but the bowler fires it on his pads, gets beaten and it hits his pads
and slower, tossed up on the middle stump, more defence from the batsman
another tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman defends it watchfully to the off side
tossed up delivery on off stump, the batsman waits and defends it to midwicket
he draws an outside edge as the batsman comes tentatively forward, it slides past slip and all the way to the boundary
he goes on the back foot and punches a low trajectory delivery to deep square leg
flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and drives it to long-on
he goes down on his knee and plays a premeditated paddle down to fine leg for a single
he charges down the pitch and drives it back past the bowler,  all along the ground
full and flighted on off, pushed back to the bowler
flat and a bit wide outside off, the batsman waits on the back foot and punches it to deep extra cover
flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and dabs it to cover point for a single
flighted and full on off stump, the batsman drives it to long-off
flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler

he loses his off stump! He though he was being too smart as he went for a lofted drive as soon as he saw some flight, but it was a doosra, it goes between the bat and the pad and hits the off stump.. (Diddy's I am coming home is the soundtrack for Patel)
this one is slightly outside off, Parthiv is quick to rock back and guide this to deep backward point
another one of those flatter delivery, now Sanga goes back and flicks it to deep backward square
he waits on the back foot for this flatter delivery and whips it to deep square leg
pushed through on the pads, the batsman goes back and nudges it to short fine
length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends it to mid-on
short of length delivery outside off, doesn't bounce much, but Parthiv slaps it to deep square leg off the front foot
he stays on the back foot and dabs it towards cover point, calls for a quick single
back of length delivery outside off, he stays in the crease and guides it to third man..
length delivery outside off, it is pushed back to the bowler, who throws it back towards the batsman..
length delivery angling in to the left-hander, it is punched down the ground to long on
goes back again and steers it past short third man for a couple
goes back to the flatter delivery and punches it to cover
lucky lucky! I am sure he didn't want to hit it there. It was a tossed up delivery, Parthiv goes for a slog sweep which takes a bit of top edge and goes to the deep midwicket boundary
comes down the pitch and tries to launch it over midwicket, gets and inside edge to deep square leg
pushed through on the stumps, Sanga comes solidly behind that one and defends
tossed up delivery, but down the leg side, Patel sweeps it to short fine and calls for a quick one
length delivery on the stumps, defended towards midwicket
back of length delivery just outside off, the batsman stays in the crease, arches back and guides it to third man
now Sanga plays it with soft hands towards mid-off for a single
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman dabs it towards mid-on and calls for a quick one
angled delivery on off and middle, Parthiv does well and flicks it to deep backward square leg boundary, the fine leg was up in the field
length ball outside off, Patel stays in the crease and gets a leading edge towards point as he defends
and he just times the length ball over the umpire's head, no show of power, just some class...
bowls a slower delivery on off stump this time, Sanga comes forward and defends it to the leg side
shortish length, doesn't bounce much, the batsman pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single
length delivery on the pads, whipped to deep backward square leg
he comes forward and steers the length delivery down to third man
good delivery, it is on a length on the off and middle line, straigthens a touch too, the batsman tries to flick it towards midwicket but gets a leading edge to third man
appeal for caught behind, but there was nothing on it. It was full and wide delivery, Parthiv chases it, but it swings past the bat
this time he strays on to the pads, Sanga flicks it with ease to fine leg
length delivery outside off is defended towards cover this time
oh Sanga! It was a length delivery outside off, easy paced, the batsman comes forward and drives it on the up through the crowded off side, no one moves
gentle length delivery that swings away from the batsman, Sanga lets it go

caught at mid-on! There is a wicket for RP Singh! Reddy's over-aggressive approach has failed him this time. He cleared his front foot out and wanted to slam this down the ground, but it hit the inside half of his bat and lobbed towards wide mid-on, the fielder moves a few steps to his right and accepts the present
length delivery on off stump, the batsman stays on the back foot and defends it towards mid-off
fuller length delivery on the off stump line, Patel comes forward and drives it to mid-on
short delivery outside off, this time Reddy waits on the back foot and pulls it from infront of his face to deep midwicket
beautiful delivery, it beats the bat as the batsman tries to play it away from the body. The batsman is trying to take his front leg out of the way every ball
length delivery, this one hits the meat of the bat, is slapped over mid-on and it goes to the boundary after one bounce
bowls a gentle outswinger which Reddy wanted to blast through off side, the ball swings past the outside edge
length delivery, the batsman flicks it to short fine leg and takes off for a single, but that went straight to the fielder and Parthiv would have been gone if there was a direct hit
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to the leg side
back of length delivery on off stump, comes with some tennis ball bounce, the batsman defends. The speed gun says 134, seemed a bit slower than that
back of length delivery on the pads, Reddy whips it off his hips and beats Murali Kartik at short fine leg, could have been stopped there by the fielder..
fuller length on off stump, Reddy is ready for it, drives it over the infield on the off side, doesn't get any timing and is lucky that the ball cleared the fielders
starts off with a length delivery that goes on with the angle and beats the batsman, who expected it to come in..
bowls a yorker outside off, which Kohli squeezes through extra cover.. Gets a hug from Ishant for that..
really goes after this full delivery outside off, makes no contact and gets beaten.. Ishant has a word with the batsman..
bowls a good fast yorker outside off, the batsman misses
he bowls a high full toss in his attempt to bowl a yorker, Kohli whips it fine on the leg side...
fuller and wider outside off, the batsman throws his bat at that, but makes no contact
length delivery, he takes a swing, but hits the toe-end and it goes to long-on on the bounce
full delivery wide outside off, he just opens the face and slices it to deep backward point using the pace of the bowler, Mishra at third-man was only a few meters away..
attempts a slower delivery, but this one goes down the leg side..
falls down at deep backward point after it took a big edge! Mishra was too slow from third man, he had a chance as the ball stayed in the air for a long long time.
big edge, it goes flying past the outstretched hands of Parthiv Patel.. It was a quicker delivery and he was going over cover, got a thick edge on that
he is unstoppable now, takes a step down and whacks the length delivery over mid-off
flatter topspinner, he waits in the crease and works it to the leg side for a single..
oh no, tossed up and wide outside off, wide called
flatter delivery on the pads, Kohli goes deep in his crease and pulls it in the gap at deep square leg, all along the ground
bowls a googly, which the batsman dabs towards empty midwicket region, the bowler runs after it, but they take a couple easily
he is messing with Mishra's line, who has bowled this flat down the leg side
tossed up delivery, Kohli comes a step down but ends up yorking himself
and again! this is some beautiful use of the feet, gets under the pitch and sends this one further over the sight screen
super shot! Comes down the pitch, gets under the flighted ball and blasts it over the sight screen
length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it to point.. And that is the end of Steyn's spell, 4 overs, 15 runs, but more importantly for RCB, no wickets..
waits in the crease and steers the length ball down to third man for a single
fuller delivery outside off, Kohli tries to whip it towards midwicket but gets an outside edge to third man, completes his half-century
attempts a yorker, bit this is a low full-toss on the stumps, the batsman flicks it to deep midwicket
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends it towards mid-on
bowls length on the pads, 138 kph, which Kohli easily whips to deep square leg
here comes the googly, the batsman spots it a little late, defends it back to the bowler
he drives it to midwicket and looks for a couple, Henriques wanted a couple too and turned back fast, but Kohli didn't move, he sends Moises back in time
he comes down the pitch and slices this one to short third man for a single
he goes for a cut off a fuller delivery, gets a thick outside edge, and it just goes between the two fielders at backward point...
back of length delivery, he goes back and punches it down the ground to long-off
full and flighted, but it's down the leg side and Kohli just has to get some bat on it... he does and it goes fine on the leg side
back of length delivery outside off, he stays on the back foot and opens the face to run it down to third man
length ball on the pads, easily tickled to deep backward square leg for a couple
slower bouncer on the stumps, the batsman goes for a pull, but gets beaten and ends up dabbing it to the left of the keeper
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and defends..
length delivery on the pads, Kohli flicks it to deep square leg for a single
length delivery outside off, he defends it towards point off the front foot

AB is gone! He has hit this long-hop straight into the hands of deep midwicket! He could have hit it anywhere, but he picks the man in the deep. Big wicket for Sunrisers just when these two were getting away with it..
fuller and flatter outside off, pushed to long-off with ease
full and flighted on off, Kohli plays one of those whippy wristy cover drives, Perera at wide long-on somehow boots it in
now Kohli charges out and gets under the flighted one, launches it really high, but it just clears Steyn at long-on
oh poor fielding in the deep, really really bad. It was a backfoot punch to deep point which Akshath Reddy allows it to go through his legs
bowls a loopy delivery, the batsman comes out of the crease and takes it on the full, drives it to long-ff
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman goes for an on the up drives, gets beaten
fuller delivery outside off, he jabs at it and drives it with some power, straight to deep cover
welcome AB, he gets a slower loopy delivery outside off, AB drives it over extra cover - it's his patented shot - over the rope with ease..
short of length delivery outside off, goes for a punch, but ends up chopping it towards cover point
bowls a slower delivery just outside off, Virat waits and waits and cuts it fine, very late, and beats the short third man easily
bowls it full outside off, AB goes for a reverse scoop, he misses and gets hit on the pads, the impact was outside off, the run a tricky single..
tossed up delivery on the middle, ABdV sweeps it with ease, down to fine leg
loopy delivery outside off, the batsman wanted to slam it to midwicket, but this is too full and he gets an inside edge towards short fine
flighted delivery outside off, he slices it to deep point off the front foot
pulls the length back a bit, the batsman stays on the back foot and punches it to long-on
flighted and the batsman takes the invitation, comes down the pitch and slaps it past the bowler, there was a long-off, but he had no chance
bowls a flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it to cover point off the back foot
waits on the back foot and punches it to the gap at deep extra cover for a couple
he makes room by moving outside leg stump and gets a thick edge down to third man
shorter this time and Kohli swivels to club it over deep midwicket, it goes more high than long, but clears the rope
back of length delivery, punched to midwicket off the back foot
AB dances down the pitch and punches the length delivery to mid-on for a single
short of length outside off, he gives it his all as he punches it off the back foot, but there is a deep cover and it goes straight to him
conventional leg spinner which Kohli punches to deep extra cover off the back foot
another nice delivery, tossed up and slow, keeps coming in from wide of the crease, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot
bowls a long-hop, but this one doesn't bounce much and AB can only pull it along the ground to deep midwicket
flatter delivery, stays a touch low and beats the attempted cut
he comes down the pitch, but gets beaten by the drift, gets and inside edge down the pitch
oh beauuutiful! tossed up from wide of the crease, it drifts in, then turns past the outside edge..
length delivery outside off, this time he comes forward and punches it to mid-off
length delivery outside off, Kohli comes forward and shoulders his arms..
back of length delivery on off stump, Kohli defends it solidly off the back foot
he waits on the back foot and dabs the length delivery on the off side for a quick single
he beats the bat with a length ball outside off as AB tries to chop it to third man without moving his feet

he has got the big fish! Ishant has got him! The crowd is stunned! It is back of length on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease to defend it, the ball just deviated enough and catches the outside edge ..
oh he beats the bat as Kohli tries his back foot punch again, but this time the ball deviates after pitching and goes past the outside edge
length delivery, but Perera bowls this one really wide..
wonderful! It's short of length, but it's wide, Kohli waits in the crease and just punches it through cover, how does he generate so much pace with those shots!
he waits on the back foot and dabs the back of length delivery towards midwicket for a single

back of length, but this is down the leg side and all Gayle has to do is to nudge it towards backward square leg, it speeds along the turf and Ashish Reddy makes a super diving save at the boundary, very well done by the fielder there
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends it solidly

and his day gets better, it's short of length and Mayank tries to pull it over midwicket, the ball comes in a bit quicker into him and he ends up getting a big leading edge, Sanga at cover swallows it..
how! What! he moves outside leg stumps and just jams this back of length delivery on the pitch, but it bounces over Ishant and then picks up speed..
back of length delivery on off stump, Gayle stays on the back foot and defends
slower yorker on the pads, he blocks it out towards deep square leg for a single
length delivery on off, Mayank is enjoying himself, he punches it on-the-up, over cover point for a boundary
that is a good shot, it was short of length on the leg side and the batsman is quick to swivel and whip it off his hips over the fine-leg boundary.. Done with ease
he makes room by moving outside leg and Ishant responds with a quick short of length delivery, gets beaten by the bounce on that
oye, snorter! Short of length, super quick, gets up on Gayle and he fends it off from right in front of his face.. That was like a boxer avoiding getting punched
short delivery on the body, Mayank is quick to get into the position to play a pull, rolls his wrists on it and plays it to deep square leg
he is not taking any chances off Steyn, defends the back of length delivery solidly
he gets up on his toes to the short of length delivery and steers it to point
bowls a back of length delivery on the middle stump line, 142 kph, Mayank defends it solidly back to the bowler
length delivery at 139 kph, but this is wide outside off, the batsman just guides it past point without much timing, Ishant has to run around from third man and does well to cut it off
cuts in from back of length outside of, the batsman defends it to the off side
another one on the pads and Mayank whips it to the deep backward square leg boundary. Steyn chases it,  but it's too quick on the turf
short of length delivery just outside off, the batsman goes for a cut, but chops it to the off side
length delivery straying on to the pads, the batsman plants his front foot down and flicks it past the diving square leg fielder for a couple
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman gets up on his toes and punches it to cover off the back foot
bowls a length delivery on off stump, the batsman goes on the back foot and defends it to mid-on
another quick delivery on a length outside off, 141 kph, shapes in a touch, Gayle defends it to the off side without moving his feet
this one is wider outside off, short of length and Gayle lets it go through..
keeps it tight around that channel outside off, Gayle defends it to the off side
super delivery, 140 kph (i don't believe this, it looked faster than that), short of length delivery outside off, carries on with the angle and beats the batsman, who gets squared up in his defence
oye oye! Short of length delivery on off stump, comes back a touch like always, it surprises Gayle with the bounce and his hands comes off the handle ast he defends
fuller swinging delivery on off stump, the batsman just punched it, almost a defensive shot, but that races past wide mid-off..
quicker delivery on the stumps, he dabs it to square leg to steal the strike
this time he pushes it softly towards mid-off for a single
almost takes down Gayle with a powerful hit down the ground, that makes it quickly to the boundary
he gets it right this time, gets under it and smacks it to deep square leg boundary, into the crowd
quicker delivery on the leg stump, he tries to whack it to deep square leg, mistimes it to square leg
tossed up delivery on the stumps, defended towards midwicket off the back foot
